competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated to a different return window, may offer only store credit or exchange, or the 30-day full-refund rule may apply only to a different product category.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from the date the customer receives the item.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the return window is not 30 days, does not provide a full refund, is measured from a different date, or excludes standard items.
